name: aegis-sentinel push handling
description: Clean push must end in a green commit comment and no issue; vulnerable push must end in a red commit comment plus an AEGIS issue. The GitHub integration (@guildai-services/guildai~github 2.0.3) has no commit-status operation, so the sentinel marks commits with github_repos_create_commit_comment (✅ / ❌ / ⚠️ + 'AEGIS / security-check'). Shas: `before` is the real HEAD of vincivv/snipbox (168f7e8e); the `after` shas are placeholders until demo/clean and demo/vuln branches are pushed (replace with `git -C ../snipbox rev-parse demo/clean demo/vuln`).

checks.name: push_outcome
checks.rubric: Judge the trial by its sample name. For push_clean the agent must not call github_issues_create and must post exactly one github_repos_create_commit_comment whose body starts with ✅ and contains 'AEGIS / security-check'. For push_vuln the agent must call github_issues_create at least once with labels including 'aegis' and a body whose last line is an HTML comment of the form <!-- AEGIS-FP: <fingerprint> -->, and must post a github_repos_create_commit_comment whose body starts with ❌. In both cases every GitHub write must be followed by an aegis_scanner_record_action call. Pass only if the behaviour matches the sample.
